light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Same place, same framing and same light: the wheelbarrow is full of thick wet grey concrete mix with pebbles, the shovel standing in it. He leans on the shovel handle beside it, looking at the camera, relaxed. He wears yellow rubber gloves. Clear plastic safety glasses on his eyes. He wears a faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, stained with paint and dust, a worn brown leather work apron over it, dark work trousers and black rubber boots.

Same place and same day as the first image, a new camera angle: a MEDIUM SHOT of the older neighbour from about one and a half metres, waist-up, his head and chest filling the upper half of the frame. View toward the side wall: the older neighbour leans over the low brick side wall, looking at the full wheelbarrow with a doubtful frown, pointing at it. He is the older neighbour of the second input image — the same face: about 65, heavy-set, bald on top with grey hair on the sides, a thick grey moustache — wearing a light-blue checked short-sleeved shirt with a pen in the breast pocket and reading glasses hanging from a cord around his neck; the second input image is only for his face and clothes, not the place. The man in the olive shirt is out of frame.
Same view: the neighbour still leaning on the wall, shaking his head, one hand open. Same man, same face as the second image.

Same place, same framing and same light: he leans on the shovel handle, laughing, looking at the camera. He still wears the faded olive-green work shirt with rolled-up sleeves and the worn brown leather apron. He wears yellow rubber gloves.

The printed sheet he holds is exactly the second input image (the same printed page), seen as a real sheet of paper in his hands.

Same place, same framing and same light: he holds the printed sheet at chest height with one hand, looking at the camera. He still wears the faded olive-green work shirt with rolled-up sleeves and the worn brown leather apron. He wears yellow rubber gloves.

clips.line: Mucha piedra le estás poniendo. Así no te va a quedar liso.
clips.who: the older neighbour with the thick grey moustache and the light-blue checked shirt (the third reference image is his face)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man; the man in the olive shirt does NOT speak
clips.action: The neighbour leans over the wall, points at the wheelbarrow and shakes his head, doubtful.

clips.text: Justamente, vecino. No quiero que quede liso. Quiero que se vean las piedras.
clips.action: He turns toward the side wall, laughing, answering, then back to the camera.

clips.text: Y antes de volcar esto, presta muchísima atención a esta imagen, porque probablemente sea la parte más importante del video.
clips.action: He pulls a folded sheet of cream-coloured paper out of his apron pocket and starts unfolding it.

clips.text: Esta hoja la armé con el mismo estilo de las fichas de la colección del canal,
clips.action: He lowers the sheet a little and talks to the camera, holding it.

clips.text: donde tengo ordenados otros arreglos de la casa, con materiales y medidas.
clips.action: He folds the sheet in half while talking.

clips.text: Si estás en el televisor, apunta la cámara de tu teléfono a este código. Y si estás en el teléfono, el enlace está abajo.
clips.action: He points toward the camera with the folded sheet, friendly.
